PHOTO 100.name: Introduction to Photography
PHOTO 100.description: Introduction to the aesthetics, history, and science of photography.

PHOTO 200.name: Photo Studio I
PHOTO 200.description: Beginning course exploring fundamentals with digital and film techniques.

PHOTO 201.name: A Chronological Survey of Photography
PHOTO 201.description: Explores photography's role in social, cultural, and historical contexts.

PHOTO 202.name: Fundamentals of Professional Photography
PHOTO 202.description: Professionally oriented, problem-based class introducing client-centered photographic techniques.

PHOTO 301.name: Beyond Photoshop: Techniques in Digital Photographic Imaging
PHOTO 301.description: Advanced digital post-processing and specialized software techniques. Bulletin credit max is 6 across repeated enrollments; modeled at 3cr for a single enrollment.

PHOTO 303.name: Professional Photography: Studio Technique and Photocomposition
PHOTO 303.description: Intermediate problem-based course focusing on studio lighting and professional image-making. Bulletin credit max is 6 across repeated enrollments; modeled at 3cr for a single enrollment.

PHOTO 401.name: Fashion Photography
PHOTO 401.description: Technical and aesthetic approaches to professional fashion photography. Bulletin credit max is 6 across repeated enrollments; modeled at 3cr for a single enrollment.

PHOTO 404.name: Professional Photography Capstone Seminar
PHOTO 404.description: Culminating course on self-marketing and professional presence.

PHOTO 406.name: Product Photography
PHOTO 406.description: Advanced course exploring product photography for print advertising. Bulletin credit max is 4 across repeated enrollments; modeled at 2cr for a single enrollment.

PHOTO 407.name: Portrait Photography
PHOTO 407.description: Contemporary portrait photography and photographic lighting investigation. Bulletin credit max is 4 across repeated enrollments; modeled at 2cr for a single enrollment.

PHOTO 495.name: Internship
PHOTO 495.description: Supervised off-campus, nongroup instruction including field experiences, practica, or internships. Bulletin credit range is 1-18; modeled at 1cr, matching the plan's own Semester 6 placement.
